name: Misaki Takashi
source:
The one place all of the students of Hakuou Academy can seek respite from their long, hard days is the School Infirmary, where they can heal their weary souls with the gentle smile and serene atmosphere surrounding their School Nurse, Misaki Takashi.

Misaki-sensei is almost always found in the infirmary during school hours, and you can never tell what he's thinking with the perpetual smile on his face. He takes care of the Dormitory in the role of the Housemaster at the same time, where he can tend to students after-hours. He also plays Counsellor for the students.

He's calm and charming, yet also stern where he needs to be to make sure kids don't get hurt. Though, he seems to be a bit of an odd-ball at times, catching you off guard with an off-the-cuff remark. But, he always seems to know what students need to make them feel better.

Special Skill: Massages
Type Preference: Someone who you can't leave alone / Someone with a beautiful physique
Personality: Calm and gentle

"If I were someone who blurted out whatever I heard, wouldn't everyone be unable to relax here in the infirmary? There are kids who confide their secrets, because they trust me."

[From English patch notes]
